CustomField.description: This account name was introduced for the Dormancy status project.
CustomField.formula:
IF(ISBLANK(MiddleName) , IF(TEXT(CustomerStatus__c) = 'Dormant',
FirstName &' '& LastName & IMAGE("/resource/Red_Alert", "IsDormant", 40, 40),
FirstName &' '& LastName )
, IF(TEXT(CustomerStatus__c) = 'Dormant',
FirstName &' '& MiddleName &' '& LastName & IMAGE("/resource/Red_Alert", "IsDormant", 40, 40),
FirstName &' '& MiddleName &' '& LastName ) )
CustomField.label: Account Name
